ruleset.name: Aleysian House Architecture
ruleset.description: Aleysian house Salesforce architecture rules (sf-enterprise-patterns skill). Authored and tested against PMD 7.16.0. Rule names map to arch_check IDs: SoqlOutsideSelector=APX001, DmlOutsideUnitOfWork=APX002, QueryWithoutUserMode=APX003, AuraEnabledReturnsSObject=APX004, AvoidLogicInTrigger(built-in)=APX005, NonBulkServiceMethod=APX006, DeeplyNestedGenerics=APX007. Suppress with @SuppressWarnings('PMD.RuleName') plus a trailing // reason comment — the arch_check wrapper blocks suppressions without reasons.

rule.name: SoqlOutsideSelector
rule.message: SOQL/SOSL outside a *Selector class — move the query into the object's selector (APX001)
rule.description: All queries live in *Selector classes: the FLS enforcement point, the query-shape review point, and the reuse point. Test classes are exempt.

property.name: allowedClassPattern
property.description: Extra class names (regex) allowed to hold queries besides *Selector

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//SoqlExpression | //SoslExpression | //MethodCallExpression[lower-case(@FullMethodName) = ('database.query','database.querywithbinds', 'database.getquerylocator','database.getquerylocatorwithbinds','database.countquery', 'database.countquerywithbinds','search.query','search.find')]) [not(ancestor::UserClass/ModifierNode[@Test = true()])] [let $owner := (ancestor::UserClass[last()]/@SimpleName, ancestor::UserTrigger/@SimpleName)[1] return not(ends-with($owner, 'Selector') or matches($owner, $allowedClassPattern))]

rule.name: DmlOutsideUnitOfWork
rule.message: Raw DML outside UnitOfWork — register with the transaction's UnitOfWork instead (APX002)
rule.description: One commit point makes ordering, rollback, and re-entry deliberate. Only UnitOfWork (plus explicitly allowlisted classes) performs DML. Test classes are exempt.

property.name: dmlAllowlistPattern
property.description: Class names (regex) allowed to perform raw DML

rule.name: QueryWithoutUserMode
rule.message: Selector query missing USER_MODE — add WITH USER_MODE (or AccessLevel.USER_MODE for dynamic queries) (APX003)
rule.description: With DTO mapping, the query is the only FLS enforcement point. Default to user mode; system-mode queries need a suppression with a reason.

rule.name: AuraEnabledReturnsSObject
rule.message: @AuraEnabled method returns an SObject type — return a DTO so the UI is decoupled from the data model (APX004)
rule.description: SObject returns couple components to the data model and do not port (React on Salesforce consumes Apex as plain JSON). Map to DTOs in the controller.

property.name: sobjectTypeRegex
property.description: Regex identifying SObject type names inside a type expression

rule.name: NonBulkServiceMethod
rule.message: Public service method takes a single SObject — take a collection so trigger and UI paths share one code path (APX006)
rule.description: Single-record service methods end up called in loops from trigger paths. Bulk-first signatures keep the shared code path governor-safe.

rule.name: DeeplyNestedGenerics
rule.message: Generic collection nested 3+ levels deep — extract a named class so the shape documents itself (APX007)
rule.description: Past two levels of nesting, the structure carries meaning nothing names. A named class documents the shape once and gives invariants a home. Map<Id, List<Contact>> is idiomatic and never flagged.

property.name: deepNestRegex
property.description: Three collection generics opened without an intervening close
